messages:
anya: Anyone hitting weird 429 bursts in quickstart when paginating + forcing token refresh? saw it on node and py.

sam: Noticed that too earlier. Can you share a tiny repro and logs?

anya: Repro: ./start-quickstart --concurrency=10 then run a script that rotates the auth token every 2s while iterating pages. Logs:
[2026-04-05T09:10:01Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=3 attempt=1
[2026-04-05T09:10:02Z] WARN auth refreshing token for acct=exp-team
[2026-04-05T09:10:02Z] ERROR http 401 -> retry
[2026-04-05T09:10:02Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=3 attempt=2
[2026-04-05T09:10:03Z] ERROR http 429 rate_limit

diego: Sounds like duplicate inflight requests for the same cursor when auth triggers a retry. node-sdk historically didn't dedupe inflight cursor retries. py/go behave differently.

sam: Quick mitigation: set env ENABLE_RETRY_DEDUPE=true in quickstart and add small REFRESH_JITTER_MS=150. That reduced spikes for me.

anya: I'll open a PR to enable dedupe in quickstart and add a short note in onboarding docs.

ci-bot: Created issue #4278: "quickstart: inflight paginator retries during token refresh" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/4278)

sam: Long term: unify SDKs to attach retry to existing inflight promise and add an integration test that simulates token expiry during pagination.

anya: Thanks all, will track in the issue and verify PR.
